signal: DataHub closed a $35M Series B led by Bessemer, rebranded from Acryl Data, and is scaling go-to-market

email.body1:
Lachlan, saw DataHub close the $35M Series B from Bessemer and drop the Acryl name to scale go-to-market.

Scaling pipeline that fast usually means more accounts in play than the team can cover before new reps ramp, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for DataHub off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Lachlan, quick follow-up for DataHub.

Post-raise, board expectations on pipeline jump faster than headcount can. Most CROs don't actually know how many meetings the team needs to book to hit the new number, so the gap surfaces late and the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings DataHub needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Lachlan, last bit of proof for DataHub.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how DataHub's reply rate likely compares to other Series-B data infra startups. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Lachlan, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing is everything right after a raise, and the fundraise-to-hiring stretch is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a Series-B motion? I'll tailor it to DataHub either way.
